slug: 2025-06-03 Chad, Mali, Senegal pursue birth registration reforms to close gaps

systems.system: Civil registration network: 747 functional primary centres across 825 councils, 292 secondary centres and 8,000 declaration points, with digitalisation of all processes and records stated as a future plan
systems.owner: Direction nationale de l'état civil; ANSAEC created in 2025
systems.tiers: primary centres in the councils (communes), secondary centres, declaration points in health facilities and villages

note: Mali's civil status director at ID4Africa 2025: 747 of 825 councils have a functional primary registration centre and digitalisation is a future plan; nothing is stated about how any council office is connected. The 825 is the document's count of councils.
